mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months signals the Fed is shifting to easing, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of macro easing episodes despite positive FEDFUNDS shocks (t-test p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the 3-month TIPS breakeven rate above 2.5% signals anticipated Fed rate hikes, compressing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d forward returns in pre-hike episodes are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) above 150,000 for 3 consecutive months signals a strengthening labor market, prompting the Fed to hold rates steady and boosting equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d forward returns in strong-labor episodes are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) below 100,000 for 3 consecutive months signals a weakening labor market, prompting the Fed to cut rates, which compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d forward returns in weak-labor episodes are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in the Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) above 105 for 3 consecutive months signals a robust supply-side expansion, prompting the Fed to hold rates steady and boosting equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d forward returns in supply-side expansion episodes are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the S&P 500 Housing Index (HOUST) below 900 for 3 consecutive months signals a cooling housing market, prompting the Fed to hold rates steady and boosting equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d forward returns in cooling episodes are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the S&P 500 Housing Index (HOUST) above 950 for 3 consecutive months signals a housing market stress, prompting the Fed to cut rates, which compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d forward returns in stress episodes are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the S&P 500 Housing Index (HOUST) above 950 for 3 consecutive months coincides with a sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over 3 months, jointly compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: coordinated monetary easing and housing stress
failure_condition: 60d forward returns in coordinated easing/stress episodes are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
